research_question: Do PIT-safe extremes in CFTC Legacy Non-Commercial Net/Open Interest predict short-horizon FX reversal over the next five trading days?

hypothesis.primary: When 104-week Net/OI percentile is at or above 80, subsequent local-currency-vs-USD return is expected to be negative; when percentile is at or below 20, subsequent return is expected to be positive.
hypothesis.economic_interpretation: Extreme speculative positioning may represent crowding and reduced marginal capacity to extend the prevailing position, creating asymmetric short-horizon reversal risk.
hypothesis.independence_from_prior_failed_test: This experiment tests positioning level/crowding, not weekly flow continuation. The failed continuation result from PR #139 is not used to tune thresholds, horizon, currency set, or gates.

universe.usd_role: USD is the common counter-currency; USD COT contract is not used in the primary signal.

signal.percentile_method: empirical rank percentile computed only from PIT-safe available observations in the trailing 104 report-date observations including t
signal.threshold_source: Canonical Weekly COT G8 interpretation standard already in use before this experiment.

fx_return_definition.orientation: positive return always means local currency strengthens versus USD
fx_return_definition.entry: first available daily FX close on or after research_available_from
fx_return_definition.exit: fifth subsequent FX trading-day close after entry

test_statistic.observation_return: reversal_signal_sign * subsequent_5d_fx_log_return, where signal_sign=-1 for percentile>=80 and +1 for percentile<=20
test_statistic.primary_panel: For each ISO calendar week of entry, equal-weight all available OOS currency observation returns in that week; calculate panel performance from this chronological weekly portfolio series.
test_statistic.directional_accuracy: pooled OOS signal observations with observation_return > 0 divided by all pooled OOS signal observations
test_statistic.panel_max_drawdown: maximum peak-to-trough loss on exp(cumulative sum of chronological weekly_panel_return)

chronology.split_rule: Within each currency, first 60 percent of eligible labeled extreme-signal observations by entry date are diagnostic-only; final 40 percent are frozen OOS evaluation.
chronology.split_rounding: floor(0.60 * N) observations assigned to diagnostic segment

governance.if_fail: Do not promote extreme COT reversal to predictive score, production signal, or sizing input. Keep COT as contextual positioning information unless a separate predeclared hypothesis is tested.
governance.if_pass: Classify only as a research candidate requiring separate confirmation or forward validation before production use.
